description: This file defines a base class for media pipeline tests, including mock objects, setup and teardown methods, and utility functions for testing media pipeline components. It includes necessary headers, uses Google Test framework, and declares class and method prototypes for test setup.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media pipeline unit tests, providing mock objects, setup/teardown methods, and utility functions for testing media pipeline behavior.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment after each test.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MediaPipeline object for testing.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the MediaPipeline object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: setPlaybackState
methods.description: Sets the playback state for testing.

methods.name: setNetworkState
methods.description: Sets the network state for testing.

methods.name: needData
methods.description: Simulates a need data event in the media pipeline for testing.
